**Opportunity:** Specialist Pre-Press Designer / Artwork Finalizer

**Location:** Remote (Colombia) | **Job Type:** Full-Time

**About Us**  
The Sign Pack (www.thesignpack.com) is a global design agency specializing in signage. We work with sign companies across the US, Canada, UK, and Australia, providing creative layouts, vehicle wraps, production files, and more. Our team is 100% remote, multicultural, and highly collaborative.

We're looking for a Pre-Press Specialist / Artwork finalizer to join our growing team. This role is part of a Design Team Unit and supports the team in delivering production-ready files according to job tickets and project manager requests. The scope includes previous verification of layout projects and converting existing designs into production-ready files (printing and/or fabrication). The specialist maintains constant communication with supervisors to ensure quality standards are met and assists by taking on tasks delegated by Project Managers.

**What You'll Do**

* Prepare, review, and deliver production-ready files based on job tickets and project requirements.
* Preflight and validate layouts to ensure accuracy, printability, and compliance with specifications.
* Convert existing designs into print- and fabrication-ready files for digital and large-format production
* Collaborate closely with Project Managers and designers to meet deadlines, quality standards and achieve client satisfaction
* Interpret job tickets and design briefs in English, ensuring all requirements are correctly executed
* Adjust and manage color profiles (CMYK, RGB, spot colors, Pantone) for accurate print output
* Identify and resolve pre-press issues such as resolution, fonts, transparency, and file structure
* Work with industry-standard file formats (PDF, EPS, TIFF, etc.) and layered design files
* Support the design team in achieving production goals and maintaining workflow efficiency
* Ensure all designs align with client expectations and project scope
* Organize and maintain project documentation and file management systems
* Communicate proactively with stakeholders regarding timelines, updates, and potential delays
* Contribute to process improvements and help build efficient pre-press workflows
* Deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines in a fast-paced, remote environment
* Provide support on additional design-related tasks as needed to ensure overall team success

**What We're Looking For**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Graphic Design or equivalent education in a creative/artistic/print production field
* **Advanced English** Proficiency (C1 - C2)
* **3+ years of experience** as a Pre-Press Specialist and/or Graphic Designer
* Experience in digital printing and visual communication.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign
* Solid understanding of Raster vs Vector, RGB vs CMYK vs Spot Colors and print production requirements.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to follow design briefs in English
* Familiarity with online tools and strong computer skills, including proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud
* Highly efficient and organized. Detail-oriented and able to meet deadlines.

**Nice To Have (Not Required)**

* Experience with vehicle graphics
* Experience with general signage design
* Experience with dimensional signage

**Why Join Us?**

* Work 100% remotely with a supportive, international team
* Collaborate on creative projects for well-known brands in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia
* Opportunities for growth and senior responsibilities over time
* Be part of a company that values teamwork, innovation, and treating all stakeholders as partners

**How to Apply to our Specialist Pre-Press Designer Position**

Please apply through Indeed and include:

* Your CV/resume in English
* A link to your **portfolio** showcasing design work (signage projects are a big plus)
* Answers to our presented application questions.

Ready to design for the global signage industry? Apply today and join The Sign Pack team!

Job Type: Full-time

Application Question(s):

* How would you rate your skills in Adobe Illustrator (beginner, intermediate, advanced)? Please share an example of a project where you used Illustrator extensively.
* What computer setup do you currently use for design work (processor, RAM, graphics capabilities)? Do you have a stable high-speed internet connection suitable for remote work (please include your average download/upload speeds if possible)?
* Do you have experience with print file preparation for large-format or digital printing? Please share with us what sort of projects you've worked on as a artwork finalizer or pre-press specialist.
* What are your monthly compensation expectations for this role? Please specify the currency.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Creative Designer, you'll play a key role in developing compelling visual content that brings brand identity to life while meeting client goals across digital, print, and AI-driven platforms. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, collaborative, detail-oriented, and passionate about design innovation and emerging creative technologies.

* **Develop and refine** brand-aligned visual concepts, ensuring cohesion across all touchpoints, including digital marketing assets, print collateral, and interfaces for AI-driven platforms.

* **Conduct trend research** and ideation to infuse daily work with fresh design perspectives, modern web patterns, and emerging technologies.
* **Build and maintain** organized, scalable design assets and components using Figma as the primary design tool.

-------------

* 5+ years of experience in a Creative Designer, Brand Designer, or similar visual design role with a strong portfolio showcasing brand-focused work across diverse media.
* Proven proficiency and day-to-day expertise with Figma.
* Solid foundation in modern design principles, including typography, color theory, layout composition, conceptualization, and modern web design standards.
* Strong track record of designing high-converting assets for digital marketing, social media, and interactive web experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to self-manage, prioritize deliverables, and thrive both autonomously and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong English communication skills (B2+ or fluent) to effectively present design rationale and interact professionally with global teams and stakeholders.

### **Not a Must but a Plus:**

* Practical familiarity or active experimentation with generative AI tools applied to creative workflows and digital interfaces.
* Experience collaborating closely with UI/UX or product design workflows.
* Familiarity with motion graphics or micro-interaction design (e.g., After Effects, Lottie).

Job Description
 Why GMF?
 GM Financial International Operations conducts business in Latin America and China. International Operations offers a wide range of wholesale and retail automotive financing products to dealers and their customers. The strength of the international business lies in its ability to tailor its products to meet unique dealer needs, consumer preferences and national requirements in local markets. Latin American country operations include Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru.
 Responsibilities
 About the Role
 The Digital Product Management team within International Operations (IO) Customer Experience is seeking a Lead Product Designer who is passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences and optimizing interfaces to enhance customer satisfaction.
This role will be part of a strategic, multi-year transformation focused on modernizing GM Financial’s servicing platform and shaping the future of how we serve our customers. The initiative brings together business, technology, data and customer experience teams to deliver simpler, more scalable and innovative capabilities, leveraging product and service design, automation and AI. Team members will have the opportunity to contribute to a high-impact transformation, collaborate across functions and markets, and help build capabilities that create lasting value for our customers and the business.
You will serve as the hands-on Lead Product Designer for the future servicing experience, executing design work across the transformation. Under the guidance of the Product Lead, you will take work from early discovery and process reimagination through detailed experience design and delivery, including research, journey and process design, user flows, wireframes, prototypes and interaction design. You will work closely with Operational Excellence and cross-functional partners across Product, Technology, Data and the business to translate future servicing processes into simple, intuitive experiences. You will be a key advocate for the customer and user, continuously bringing their needs, feedback and perspectives into product and design decisions throughout the transformation.
 In This Role You Will
 Shape and execute the UX vision for the future servicing experience, translating transformation objectives and user needs into simple, cohesive experiences. 
 Lead hands-on design from discovery through delivery and iteration, including journey and process design, user flows, wireframes, prototypes and detailed experience design. 
 Partner with Product, Operational Excellence, Technology and other cross-functional teams to reimagine servicing processes, translating complex user, business and operational needs into effective experience solutions. 
 Bring the voice of customers and users into product and design decisions through research, prototyping and user testing to understand needs, validate assumptions and refine solutions. 
 Facilitate design and problem-solving workshops to align cross-functional teams, explore opportunities and move complex experience decisions forward. 
 Present and advocate for design recommendations, clearly articulating customer evidence, design rationale and trade-offs behind key experience decisions. 
 Apply and contribute to design systems and experience standards, creating consistent and scalable experiences across products, journeys and markets. 
 Use customer feedback, behavioral data and experience measures to evaluate outcomes and identify opportunities to improve the experience. 
 Qualifications
 What makes you an ideal candidate?
 Strong analytical skills to interpret user data, customer feedback and UX metrics and translate insights into design improvements. 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills across diverse teams and stakeholders. 
 Strong understanding of user research principles, with experience conducting usability testing and translating findings into design decisions. 
 Deep understanding of interaction and visual design principles. 
 Ability to create journey maps, process flows, user flows, wireframes, mockups and interactive prototypes using tools such as Figma, Sketch or Adobe XD. 
 Ability to understand complex business requirements, user needs and technical constraints and translate them into intuitive design solutions. 
 Experience working in Agile or Scrum product development environments. 
 Skilled in presenting complex design concepts and clearly articulating design decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Understanding of UX metrics, A/B testing and performance analysis to evaluate and continuously improve experiences. 
 Fluency in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.
 Additional Knowledge And Skills
 Working effectively within an AI enabled environment:
 Ability to use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support daily work
 Skills in evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, compliance, and bias
 Experience integrating AI into workflows to improve efficiency or insights
 Familiarity with AI assisted research, summarization, and content generation
 Understanding of responsible AI use, including ethics and data protection 
 Experience & Education
 7+ years of experience in Product Design, UX Design, UI/Visual Design, UX Research or related roles.
 Proven ability to lead UX initiatives and design projects from discovery through delivery and iteration. 
 Bachelor’s degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Design or a related field.

vacantes.descripcion:
📍Medellín/Bogotá, Colombia. 
 Diseñar es conectar con lo que el cliente y el usuario siente, piensa y hace para crear soluciones que enamoren y destaquen. ¡Vamos a hacer vibrar juntos con ideas que marquen la diferencia! ¡En Bancolombia, no solo trabajamos, pensamos en grande!
 ¿Cuáles serán tus retos? 
 Buscamos una persona creativa, curiosa y apasionada por el diseño de experiencias digitales que ayuden a las personas a mejorar su bienestar financiero.
Tu énfasis será en diseño UI, pero debe poder llegar también a definiciones UX.
Tu principal responsabilidad será transformar información compleja, datos analíticos, comportamientos financieros e insights de usuario en experiencias claras, relevantes y accionables que impulsen la adopción de hábitos positivos y acompañen a las personas en la toma de mejores decisiones financieras.
Serás responsable de conectar las necesidades de los usuarios, los objetivos de negocio y las capacidades analíticas para diseñar experiencias simples, personalizadas y de alto impacto que generen valor tanto para los clientes como para la organización. Inspirado en la visión de Bienestar Financiero de convertir datos en experiencias hiperpersonalizadas y acompañamiento relevante para los clientes.
 Diseñarás experiencias digitales centradas en las necesidades y comportamientos de los usuarios. 
 Transformarás hallazgos de investigación, analítica e indicadores en experiencias comprensibles y accionables. 
 Diseñarás flujos, arquitecturas de información e interfaces que faciliten la adopción de hábitos financieros saludables. 
 Construirás wireframes, prototipos y experiencias de alta fidelidad alineadas al sistema de diseño. 
 Participarás en la definición de estrategias de personalización y contextualización de experiencias. 
 Diseñarás experiencias que conecten información financiera, recomendaciones y acciones concretas para los clientes. 
 Propondrás soluciones creativas que reduzcan la complejidad de conceptos financieros y los conviertan en interacciones simples. 
 Realizarás pruebas de usabilidad y validaciones con usuarios para iterar y mejorar continuamente las soluciones. 
 Trabajarás de manera colaborativa con equipos de producto, negocio, analítica, desarrollo e investigación. 
 Acompañarás la implementación y entrega de diseños bajo metodologías ágiles. 
 Participarás activamente en comunidades de práctica, compartiendo conocimiento y aprendiendo de otros diseñadores. 
 ¿Qué te hará exitoso/a en el rol? 
 Profesional graduado en ingeniería de sistemas, diseño, administración de empresas y/o carreras afines. 
 Conocimientos requeridos: 
 Diseño visual UI. 
 Figma y su ecosistema. 
 Manejo en sistema de diseño. 
 Validaciones de usuario. 
 Uso de IA para acelerar y potenciar decisiones de diseño. 
 Conocimientos deseables: 
 Skill prototype first. 
 Herramientas de creatividad. 
 Facilitación de espacios. 
 Interfaces UX. 
 Experiencia requerida: 
 Mínimo dos años de experiencia en roles de diseño. 
 Mínimo dos años construyendo user flows y prototipos interactivos. 
 Buena capacidad de comunicación, trabajo en equipo e ingenio. 
 Capacidad de autogestión y autocapacitación. 
 Iniciativa, recursividad y autoaprendizaje. 
 ¿Qué te ofrecemos? 
 Al año recibirás 14,12 salarios legales y 4,28 salarios extralegales garantizados. 
 De acuerdo con los resultados recibirás hasta el 47,37% de remuneración variable sobre el salario anual. 
 Hasta 20 días de vacaciones remuneradas. 
 Contratación a término indefinido. 
 Planes de ahorro, financiación y exenciones bancarias. Seguros de vida, convenios. ¡Y mucho más! 
 En Bancolombia, promovemos el aprendizaje continuo, la colaboración y el bienestar. 
 Si crees que nuestro propósito puede sumar al tuyo, haz clic en aplicar a esta vacante, y ¡juntos pensemos en grande! 🚀

As a Senior Digital-First Designer working hybrid in Bogotá, Colombia, you’ll be a part of the marketing department of TTEC. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in Colombia says it all! #experienceTTEC.
As a Digital-First Senior Designer on the Marketing team, you will play a key role in two areas: translating business information into compelling visual products that support our go-to-market, executive communications, and brand initiatives, and leading the creation and evolution of web assets and experiences across TTEC’s ecosystem of brands (Percepta, TTEC & TTEC Digital).
This hybrid role sits between UX/UI, visual creativity, and brand design, with a strong focus on delivering high-performing, visually compelling, and user-centered web experiences. You will drive innovation across TTEC and Percepta's websites, exploring and applying new approaches in interactivity, multimedia, design systems, and AI-enabled experiences that elevate campaign effectiveness and web engagement. You will act as the primary design leader on the PERCEPTA brand department, crafting its communications and digital presence, while serving as the UX/UI leader across the TTEC web ecosystem.
You will also contribute to the development of presentations, business communications, and information-rich marketing assets for PERCEPTA, applying strong storytelling, information design, and visual communication principles to simplify complex concepts and improve audience understanding. Strong understanding of modern web design principles, information architecture, responsive design, HTML fundamentals, and real-time prototyping tools such as Figma and Webflow is essential.
A significant part of the role involves partnering closely with content, marketing, and implementation teams to continuously improve the user experience, visual quality, and performance of our web channels. This includes designing and refining site architecture, wireframes and templates, navigation systems, landing pages, user journeys, campaign experiences, and digital assets that keep our brands modern, cohesive, and effective. You will be expected to think beyond aesthetics, helping teams shape narratives, simplify complexity, and transform business challenges into effective communication and digital experience elements.
 What You Will Do
 Digital ideation: Bring fresh ideas for worldwide leader brands in the customer experience market, creating exciting opportunities for new thinking, research & interaction in the digital field. Seek to implement the most innovative tools on TTEC's web channels in terms of user experience, animation components, and graphic resources that capture the audience's attention and transform it into conversion and outcomes. Develop engaging UI and interaction designs, incorporating thoughtful data visualization and visual elements that improve comprehension and drive user engagement. Test, measure, and refine digital assets, web experiences, and visual solutions to optimize performance and effectiveness. Create low- and high-fidelity wireframes, prototypes, and experience concepts that support decision-making and accelerate implementation.
 Creative execution: Lead the development of design elements, presentations, sales materials, and other high-visibility corporate and marketing documents. Facilitate stakeholder discussions to define requirements, challenge assumptions, and align creative solutions with business objectives. Present design rationales and creative recommendations to stakeholders, to produce effective visual communications.
 Project management: Independently manage medium- to large-scale design initiatives from concept through final delivery. Provide strategic recommendations on content structure, storytelling approaches, and visual frameworks that improve communication effectiveness in our web channels and communications. Exercise judgment when balancing business priorities, stakeholder expectations, timelines, and creative quality.
 Cross-department collaboration: Partner directly with marketing leaders, product teams, subject matter experts, and senior stakeholders to transform complex ideas into clear and engaging visual communications. Analyze, reorganize, and synthesize large volumes of information to improve clarity, narrative flow, and audience comprehension.
 Brand & creative management: Ensure consistency with brand standards while identifying opportunities to evolve and elevate visual systems, design patterns and communication approaches. Present design rationale and recommendations confidently to stakeholders and incorporate feedback effectively for highly efficient products. Identify opportunities to improve workflows, presentation standards, templates, and design processes.
 Tech Skills
 What you bring:
 Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Digital Design, UX/UI, or a related field.
 Proficiency in English at a bilingual conversational level is a MUST-HAVE. All work is carried out alongside a global team of marketing professionals across several countries.
 6+ years of experience in graphic and digital design, with a strong focus on web-based environments.
 Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, responsive design, and user-centered methodologies.
 A strong portfolio that showcases creativity, attention to detail, design thinking, excellent graphic quality and a wide range of design styles.
 Expert-level proficiency in digital design tools, including Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite of tools (Word, Powerpoint). Desired knowledge in Webflow.
 Desired proficiency in AI-tools aimed at UX/UI development / prototyping and innovation.
 Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern layout frameworks to effectively collaborate with development teams and ensure design feasibility.
 Experience designing and optimizing websites, landing pages, microsites, and interactive web components for B2B audiences.
 Familiarity with design systems and component libraries to ensure consistency and scalability across digital assets.
 Awareness of accessibility standards (WCAG) and best practices for inclusive digital design.
 Bonus points for experience in interactive design, motion graphics, basic video production.
 Soft Skills
 Critical thinking to understand, reorganize, simplify, conceptualize, and visualize information more effectively in digital environments.
 Ability to lead the creative team in the development or iteration of digital innovations, and present design concepts clearly and effectively.
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a global team in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
 What You Can Expect
 Excellent compensation (above standard) & indefinite contract.
 Great work/life balance: hybrid routine, regular office shift.
 A company supportive of your career and professional development.
 Paid time off (PTO) and wellness and healthcare benefits (prepaid medicine).
 A great compensation package and performance bonus opportunities, benefits you'd expect and maybe a few that would pleasantly surprise you (like tuition reimbursement).
 This position is eligible to participate in an annual incentive program.
 About TTEC
 Our business is about making customers happy. That's all we do. Since 1982, we've helped companies build engaged, pleased, profitable customer experiences powered by our combination of humanity and technology. On behalf of many of the world's leading iconic and hypergrowth brands, we talk, message, text, and video chat with millions of customers every day. These exceptional customer experiences start with you.

As a global company, we know diversity is our strength because it enables us to view things from different vantage points and for you to bring value to the table in your own unique way.

 About The Role
 As a Senior Creative Designer, you'll play a key role in developing compelling visual content that brings brand identity to life while meeting client goals across digital, print, and AI-driven platforms.  Responsibilities

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Content) to translate creative briefs into impactful visual assets and engaging user experiences.
 Lead design execution across multiple simultaneous projects, ensuring all deliverables meet high standards of quality, accuracy, and brand consistency while adhering to project timelines.
 Conduct trend research and ideation to infuse daily work with fresh design perspectives, modern web patterns, and emerging technologies.
 Build and maintain organized, scalable design assets and components using Figma as the primary design tool.
 Engage actively in critique and feedback sessions, iterating designs quickly based on stakeholder input and fostering open, constructive communication.
 Optimize visual assets across digital channels, ensuring high performance, responsive layouts, and alignment with target audience expectations.
 About You
 The essentials:
 5+ years of experience in a Creative Designer, Brand Designer, or similar visual design role with a strong portfolio showcasing brand-focused work across diverse media.

 Demonstrated ability to self-manage, prioritize deliverables, and thrive both autonomously and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong English communication skills (B2+ or fluent) to effectively present design rationale and interact professionally with global teams and stakeholders.
 Not a Must But a Plus
 Practical familiarity or active experimentation with generative AI tools applied to creative workflows and digital interfaces.

 About Monks
 Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. You’ll also partner with the data team on A/B testing and help optimize hero images and carousel systems across their brands.

 Systems & Standards
 Follow standardized hero and carousel image systems across multiple brands.

Company Overview 
 Blue Tees Golf is a dynamic, fast-growing consumer electronic golf technology company that is revolutionizing the golfing experience. We specialize in the design, development, and distribution of innovative products that enhance the performance and enjoyment of golfers worldwide. We aspire to be more than another golf technology brand. We champion the progression of the game and motivate golfers to Play Different®. That’s why at Blue Tees Golf our mission is to make high-quality equipment accessible to all golfers.
 Job Summary 
 Blue Tees Golf is seeking a UX/UI Designer with connected-hardware experience to create intuitive, cohesive experiences across physical devices and digital interfaces. You will own assigned design workstreams from information architecture and user flows through high-fidelity UI, interactive prototyping, engineering handoff, and implementation review.
 You will collaborate with UX, Product, Engineering, QA, and external development partners to translate user needs, product requirements, and technical constraints into practical, polished designs. This hands-on individual contributor role requires strong UX problem solving, attention to visual detail, and clear communication across a distributed team.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own assigned design workstreams: Deliver UX/UI deliverables for launch monitors, connected mobile apps, and simulation experiences. Clarify requirements, identify dependencies, and surface decisions or delivery risks early.
 Define end-to-end experiences: Create information architecture, user journeys, interaction models, flows, and wireframes that connect hardware and software experiences. Address key states, edge cases, errors, and recovery paths.
 Create polished interfaces and prototypes: Develop high-fidelity screens, visual assets, and rapid interactive prototypes to explore concepts, communicate functionality, and validate solutions.
 Collaborate across teams and suppliers: Partner with Product Managers, software and hardware engineers, QA, and a China-based supplier to balance usability, technical feasibility, and launch priorities.
 Apply shared design standards and tools: Use approved components and interaction patterns, document design-system gaps, and apply AI-assisted tools to accelerate exploration and prototyping. Review outputs for usability, consistency, and feasibility.
 Support research and iteration: Participate in usability testing, synthesize findings, and incorporate user feedback, subject-matter expertise, and available analytics into design decisions.
 Ensure implementation quality: Review builds against design specifications, document actionable UX/UI issues in the agreed tracking tool, and collaborate with Engineering and QA through resolution.
 Maintain clear documentation and handoffs: Keep Figma files, specifications, design rationale, and progress updates organized so internal teams and external partners can implement designs effectively across time zones.
 Qualifications and Requirements 
 Required 
 Hands-on experience designing connected-hardware experiences that bridge physical devices and digital interfaces, including collaboration with hardware, firmware, and software teams.
 A portfolio demonstrating UX process, product thinking, strong UI craft, and shipped connected-product work, with clear explanations of your contributions, design decisions, and implementation constraints.
 Strong proficiency in Figma and FigJam, including component libraries, high-fidelity UI, interactive prototyping, and developer handoff.
 Ability to translate complex requirements into clear information architecture, intuitive user flows, and detailed interaction specifications.
 Experience working within a design system and applying consistent interaction patterns, accessibility principles, and inclusive design practices.
 Experience supporting usability testing, synthesizing findings, and using research, customer feedback, or analytics to improve designs.
 Ability to independently progress assigned work while collaborating closely with a UX lead and cross-functional partners.
 Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills in English, including explaining design tradeoffs and providing clear asynchronous updates.
 Ability to collaborate with a China-based supplier through organized documentation and agreed meeting windows.
 Availability for a minimum of two hours of overlap with headquarters working hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Pacific Time, plus agreed supplier coordination windows. Specific collaboration hours will be established during hiring.
 Willingness to learn golf fundamentals, scoring, launch monitor functionality, and simulation workflows. Prior golf knowledge is not required.
 Preferred 
 Experience designing interfaces or interactions for Unity-based applications, 3D software, video games, or simulation products.
 Experience with golf technology, sports or fitness products, consumer electronics, or companion mobile apps.
 Experience designing device onboarding, connectivity, or performance-data experiences.
 Familiarity with AI-assisted design and rapid prototyping workflows.
 Familiarity with Linear, Jira, Confluence, or similar project tracking and documentation tools.

Company Overview 
 Blue Tees Golf is a dynamic, fast-growing consumer electronic golf technology company that is revolutionizing the golfing experience. We specialize in the design, development, and distribution of innovative products that enhance the performance and enjoyment of golfers worldwide. We aspire to be more than another golf technology brand. We champion the progression of the game and motivate golfers to Play Different®. That’s why at Blue Tees Golf our mission is to make high-quality equipment accessible to all golfers.
 Job Summary 
 The Senior Ecommerce UX/UI Designer will be a senior, hands-on digital designer responsible for creating premium ecommerce experiences that are visually elevated, conversion-focused, and built for scale. This person will own design across the Blue Tees Golf website, Shopify experiences, landing pages, product pages, collection pages, email/SMS, campaign extensions, funnels, and other digital customer touchpoints.
 This is not a traditional UI/UX role focused only on screens and wireframes. This is a growth-oriented ecommerce design role where visual craft, customer journey thinking, conversion optimization, Funnel understanding, Figma discipline, proactive problem solving, and revenue impact are all essential.
 The right candidate will be able to identify a broken customer experience, diagnose the issue, propose a solution, design it, collaborate with development, QA the implementation, measure performance, and continue improving the experience over time. This is a design role, not a front-end engineering role, but the ideal candidate understands development constraints and can partner closely with developers through handoff, QA, and iteration.
 Portfolio is required. Strong candidates should be able to show not only polished visual work, but also the business or customer problem, the audience insight, the design hypothesis, the solution, implementation considerations, and the impact of their work.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own digital design across ecommerce, landing pages, product pages, collection pages, campaign pages, email/SMS, funnels, and other digital customer touchpoints.
 Design premium, conversion-focused ecommerce experiences that improve customer understanding, product discovery, add-to-cart behavior, checkout flow, and overall path to purchase.
 Partner closely with Ecommerce, Growth, Creative, Product Marketing, and Development to translate business priorities into high-performing digital experiences.
 Redesign and optimize landing pages, PDPs, collection pages, navigation, cart experiences, bundles, upsells, cross-sells, subscription flows, reviews, and post-purchase touchpoints.
 Collaborate with the Ecommerce Manager to evaluate current site performance, review customer behavior, identify friction points, and prioritize UX and design improvements.
 Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer feedback, testing results, and performance data to inform design decisions.
 Build clear design hypotheses and contribute to a practical CRO and A/B testing roadmap.
 Create polished, developer-ready Figma files from wireframes through final responsive designs, prototypes, components, annotations, and handoff documentation.
 Partner with front-end developers and overseas development teams to scope feasibility, provide design direction, QA implementation, and ensure final execution meets brand and UX standards.
 Design mobile-first ecommerce experiences with a strong understanding of how customer behavior and conversion patterns change across devices.
 Create high-quality email/SMS designs for promotional campaigns, launches, lifecycle flows, transactional experiences, and reusable templates.
 Create custom visual assets, typography treatments, page layouts, iconography, product graphics, campaign systems, and motion or interactive elements that feel premium and brand-right.
 Maintain and evolve reusable digital design systems, Shopify components, page patterns, landing page modules, email templates, and brand-consistent digital guidelines.
 Study competitors, category leaders, ecommerce UX patterns, emerging design tools, consumer behavior, and conversion trends.
 Use modern AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, concept exploration, prototyping, asset development, and production workflows while maintaining strong taste and craft.
 Move quickly across multiple projects while maintaining a high bar for detail, visual quality, usability, and commercial impact.
 Proactively identify opportunities to improve the customer experience instead of waiting for direction or maintaining the status quo.
 Qualifications and Requirements 
 Required 
 6-10+ years of relevant digital design, ecommerce design, UX/UI, product design, or growth design experience.
 Strong portfolio demonstrating ecommerce design work, landing pages, PDPs, digital campaigns, mobile-first experiences, customer journey improvements, and polished visual execution.
 Deep experience designing for ecommerce, DTC, Shopify, or high-conversion digital purchase experiences.
 Expert-level Figma skills, including components, variants, auto layout, responsive states, prototyping, annotations, and clean developer handoff.
 Strong visual design craft across typography, layout, hierarchy, composition, product storytelling, and digital brand systems.
 Clear understanding of ecommerce CRO, paid traffic funnels, customer journeys, merchandising, product education, offers, subscriptions, bundles, and conversion psychology.
 Experience designing landing pages and funnels for different audiences, products, campaigns, offers, and traffic sources.
 Strong understanding of Shopify or Shopify Plus, including themes, apps, page templates, mobile responsiveness, front-end constraints, and development realities.
 Ability to work directly with developers through scoping, handoff, QA, launch, and iteration.
 Experience using analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer behavior insights, or testing data to inform design decisions.
 Experience designing email and SMS creative for promotional campaigns, launches, lifecycle flows, transactional moments, or reusable templates.
 Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud, including tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects.
 Working knowledge of modern AI tools and how they can improve design research, ideation, prototyping, production, and workflow speed.
 Strong attention to detail, high ownership, proactive thinking, and the ability to identify problems before they are assigned.
 Ability to balance brand quality, usability, technical feasibility, speed, and business performance.
 Preferred 
 Direct experience with Shopify Plus.
 Experience with low-code or no-code tools such as Webflow, Framer, or similar platforms.
 Experience with CRO tools, A/B testing platforms, GA4, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics and behavior tools.
 Experience with Klaviyo or comparable email/SMS platforms.
 Experience with motion design, Lottie animations, micro-interactions, or interactive product storytelling.
 Working knowledge of 3D product visualization tools such as Blender, Redshift, or similar platforms.
 Experience collaborating with overseas development teams.
 Experience in consumer electronics, sports, golf, lifestyle, DTC, retail, or premium product brands.
 Experience designing for subscriptions, memberships, bundles, upsells, cross-sells, or post-purchase journeys.
 Performance marketing awareness and understanding of what happens before and after the click.
 Education & Experience 
 Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, UX/UI Design, Product Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
 Equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio may be considered in place of a degree.
 6-10+ years of relevant digital design experience preferred, with significant direct experience in ecommerce, DTC, growth design, or conversion-focused digital experiences.
 Portfolio required.
 Benefits 
 Competitive salary and bonuses
 Medical, dental, vision & supplemental coverage
 401(k) with 3% match
 Unlimited paid time off, including holidays and sick leave
 Remote

vacantes.descripcion:
Descripción del Cargo:
 En Keppri buscamos un Diseñador de Procesos con enfoque en Gobierno de Datos e Información para levantar, diseñar, documentar e implementar los procesos del modelo operativo de Gobierno de la Información en el sector financiero. Trabajará con Negocio, Tecnología, Ingeniería de Datos, Riesgo, Cumplimiento y Seguridad para que los procesos sean claros, controlados, medibles y aplicables desde un piloto hasta su escalamiento a otros dominios de datos.
 Conocimiento en:
 Arquitectura y diseño de procesos orientados a datos: levantamiento As-Is, diseño To-Be y modelado en BPMN 2.0 o notación equivalente (Bizagi, Visio u otras).
 Gobierno de datos e información: marcos de referencia como DAMA-DMBOK, roles de Data Owner, Data Steward y Data Custodian, dominios y subdominios de datos.
 Gestión de calidad de datos, incidentes de datos, metadatos (negocio, técnicos y operativos), linaje y ciclo de vida del dato.
 Gestión de acceso a datos, intercambio de información, gestión de cambios sobre datos y estructuras, y gestión de excepciones.
 Diseño de controles preventivos, detectivos y correctivos, matrices RACI, SLA, reglas de escalamiento e indicadores de cumplimiento, desempeño y riesgo.
 Gestión y conservación de evidencias y trazabilidad entre procesos, roles, controles, riesgos e indicadores.
 Responsabilidades:
 Inventariar y levantar los procesos actuales de Gobierno de la Información con responsables funcionales y técnicos, identificando actividades manuales, reprocesos, duplicidades, dependencias, riesgos y ausencia de controles.
 Diseñar los procesos objetivo del modelo operativo: fuentes canónicas, calidad de datos, incidentes de datos (incluyendo dominios compartidos), metadatos, linaje, acceso a datos, ciclo de vida del dato, evidencias, intercambio de información, cambios sobre datos, dominios y subdominios, excepciones y monitoreo y reporte.
 Documentar cada proceso: objetivo, alcance, entradas, salidas, responsables, sistemas, actividades, puntos de decisión, reglas de negocio, controles, SLA, evidencias e indicadores.
 Diseñar formularios, registros, listas de verificación, matrices, plantillas, procedimientos e instructivos operativos.
 Facilitar talleres de validación con las áreas involucradas y resolver vacíos, duplicidades y conflictos de responsabilidad entre procesos.
 Preparar guías prácticas, flujos resumidos y material de consulta para Data Owners, Data Stewards y Data Custodians, y definir el control de versiones de los procesos.
 Acompañar el piloto en un dominio de datos, medir desviaciones y puntos de fricción, ajustar procesos y controles y entregar una versión estabilizada y reutilizable.
 Definir el modelo operativo de la reportería legal y regulatoria de entidades offshore como base para la adopción de herramientas de consolidación y reporte.
 Educación y Experiencia:
 Profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, de Sistemas, Administración o carreras afines.
 Más de 5 años de experiencia comprobada en diseño y optimización de procesos.
 Experiencia demostrable en proyectos de gobierno de datos, calidad de datos o gestión de información.
 Deseable: experiencia en el sector financiero, reportería regulatoria y herramientas de catálogo o gobierno de datos (Collibra, Informatica, Purview, Alation u otras).
 Deseable: certificación DAMA CDMP, BPM o afines.

Job Description
 Join Publicis Sapient as a UX/UI Designer to craft impactful digital experiences for a major multinational tobacco industry client .
This role focuses on designing for direct-to-consumer (D2C) digital ecosystems — blending creativity, data insights, and usability to optimize customer journeys. You’ll collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and be assigned to one of two areas:
 Top of Funnel: pages that attract and engage new visitors — homepages, landing pages, campaigns, and discovery experiences.
 Bottom of Funnel: paths that convert visitors — product pages, forms, checkout flows, and account experiences.
 Your Impact
 Design website updates, new pages, and layouts from brief to handover, across desktop and mobile.
 Map and enhance user journeys within your assigned funnel stage to fix drop-off points.
 Use analytics, user research, and A/B test data to inform design decisions.
 Produce wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI in Figma, extending design systems when needed.
 Collaborate closely with developers, strategists, copywriters, and product owners to deliver seamless experiences.
 Design to WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards, with SEO and performance in mind.
 Participate in design reviews, workshops, and client presentations; clearly communicate design rationale.
 Prototype ideas and support user testing in collaboration with optimization colleagues.
 Share early work, give and receive critique, and contribute to common design patterns.
 Qualifications
 Skills & Experience
 5+ years of experience in visual design, with a strong portfolio showcasing digital design work.
 Strong UX and UI craft — from information architecture and user flows to visual design and responsive layout.
 Fluency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and design system management.
 Experience collaborating with and presenting to clients or senior stakeholders.
 Understanding of how design impacts acquisition and conversion metrics.
 Working knowledge of accessibility principles (WCAG) and HTML/CSS feasibility.
 Prototyping skills and an analytical mindset suited for data-driven problem solving.
 Fluent written and spoken English.
 Comfortable working in the tobacco category.
 Set Yourself Apart With
 Agency or consultancy background.
 Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO), A/B testing, or experimentation tools.
 Design experience for CMS-driven or component-based websites.
 Skills in motion or interaction design.
 Comfort using AI-powered design tools to enhance creative output.
 Additional Information
 An inclusive workplace that promotes diversity and collaboration.
 Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities.
 Competitive compensation and benefits package.
 Flexibility to support work-life balance.
 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family.
 Wellness program and employee assistance.
 As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com

 Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

Blacksmith Agency
 Design
 Full time
 Remote (Latin America)
 About The Role
 Blacksmith Agency builds websites and marketing programs for clients across the US. As Senior Product Designer, Design Systems at Blacksmith, you own how our client design systems get built. You take a brand and a few reference sites, then extract the pattern into a working system: tokens, variables, modes, and core components a build pipeline can execute without asking you questions. Precision is the job.
This is a senior, systems-first seat. Not one-off pages, not maintenance. You stand up new systems fast and get them right the first time, across several client brands at once.
 What You Will Own
 Build token architecture in Figma using variables, modes, and semantic naming our pipeline can read predictably.
 Ship core component libraries that hold up across an entire site, not just a homepage.
 Document the system so a developer or an automated pipeline can execute it without questions.
 Work across several client brands at once, each looking distinctly different, with the same structural rigor.
 What You Bring
 4+ years designing for the web, with real design system work in your portfolio.
 Fluency in Figma variables, component properties, auto layout, and variants. Actual architecture, not just tidy files.
 A portfolio where the work looks different from client to client but the rigor underneath is the same.
 Strong English and overlap with US business hours.
 How To Apply
 Apply in two minutes at the link. Your application is reviewed once you finish a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment, so use the same email throughout.

Job Description
 Cultural Care Au Pair is looking for a Visual & Multimedia Designe r to join our in-house Creative team. Based in our Bogotá office, the designer will be part of a global Creative team with colleagues in Zurich and Boston. This broad, hands-on role will create visual content for global marketing initiatives across digital, social and print, as well as edit short-form social videos.
You will turn creative briefs and day-to-day requests into engaging, on-brand visual content. The role includes creating and adapting campaign assets, paid and organic social content, presentations, print materials and other marketing touchpoints, as well as editing short-form videos and creating simple animations.
As part of the Creative team, you will work closely with colleagues in Zurich and Boston, as well as Marketing, Paid Media and Social, following the team’s creative direction, brand standards and processes.
 What You'll Do
 Design and deliver high-quality marketing assets across digital, paid and organic social, email, web, presentations, print and events. 
 Translate briefs, campaign objectives and day-to-day requests into engaging visual solutions that meet audience needs and business goals. 
 Support design execution and production, including adapting, resizing, localizing and updating existing creative across formats, channels and markets. 
 Create and develop visual assets for Au Pair audiences globally, while ensuring consistency with the Cultural Care brand and broader creative direction. 
 Edit short-form social videos using supplied footage, including selecting clips, pacing, captions, on-screen messaging, graphics, animations, music and platform-specific formats, while collaborating closely with the Video team. 
 Collaborate closely with designers and video colleagues in Zurich and Boston, and partner with AP Marketing, Paid Media and Social throughout the creative process. 
 Apply feedback accurately and efficiently while maintaining a high level of visual quality, attention to detail and brand consistency. 
 Manage multiple requests and deadlines, maintain organized working files and prepare final assets correctly for handover, publishing or production. 
 Stay current with visual, social and digital trends, platform requirements and emerging tools, including AI-supported creative workflows. 
 You might be a great fit for this role if:
 You are a versatile, hands-on designer with strong visual craft and a strong portfolio across different channels and formats. You enjoy developing new ideas as well as working efficiently on adaptations, production and day-to-day creative requests. 
 You understand how typography, layout, imagery and colour work together to create clear, engaging and on-brand communication for different audiences and platforms. 
 You are comfortable working across static design and video editing, collaborating with different teams and responding to creative direction and feedback. You are organised, curious and able to manage several projects in a fast-moving international environment. 
 Requirements
 Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Digital Media or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 Approximately 3–5 years of professional design experience within an agency, in-house Creative team or marketing environment. 
 A strong portfolio showing hands-on visual design and production work across print, digital and social channels, with examples of video or motion work where available. 
 Strong understanding of typography, layout, colour, imagery, composition and brand systems. 
 Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign, with working knowledge of Figma or similar collaborative design tools. 
 Experience editing short-form, mobile-first content for paid and organic social using Premiere Pro or similar software. After Effects, animation or motion graphics skills are a plus. 
 Experience using AI tools to support creative development, design production and content creation. 
 Strong organisational and communication skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple requests while collaborating across teams, locations and time zones. 
 Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are considered an advantage. 
 Willingness and ability to travel within Latin America and internationally, as needed 
 Please note that only applicants with an accompanying portfolio will be considered.
 About The Team
 At Cultural Care Au Pair, we believe that cultural exchange has the power to make the world a more welcoming, understanding, and open place. As the largest and most experienced au pair organization in the world, we build global families by bringing together international visitors with American hosts—providing meaningful childcare for families, an unforgettable year in America for au pairs, and a culturally enriching experience for all. If you’re ready to expand your own horizons we invite you to be a part of our global team of problem-solvers, relationship-builders, and innovators. Join us as we continue to bring the world a little bit closer together, one family at a time.
Cultural Care Au Pair is associated with EF (Education First), the world leader in international education. At EF we believe that the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we have brought millions of people to see new places, experience new cultures, and learn new things about the world and themselves. Our culturally immersive education programs—focused on language, travel, cultural exchange, and academics—create students of the world, and turn dreams into international opportunities.
An equal opportunity employer, Cultural Care Au Pair is committed to inclusion and belonging across race, ethnicity, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, parental status, experience and everything else that makes you, well…you."
Learn more about Cultural Care Au Pair: https://www.culturalcare.com/

Company Description
 Experian es una empresa global de datos y tecnología que impulsa oportunidades para personas y negocios en todo el mundo. Ayudamos a redefinir prácticas de préstamos, descubrir y prevenir el fraude, simplificar la atención médica, crear soluciones de marketing y obtener perspectivas más profundas del mercado automotriz, todo utilizando nuestra combinación única de datos, análisis y software. También asistimos a millones de personas a alcanzar sus metas financieras y ayudarles a ahorrar tiempo y dinero.
Operamos en una variedad de mercados, desde servicios financieros hasta atención médica, automotriz, agroindustria, seguros y muchos otros segmentos industriales.
Invertimos en personas y nuevas tecnologías avanzadas para desbloquear el poder de los datos. Como empresa del índice FTSE 100, cotizada en la Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN), contamos con un equipo de 22,500 personas en 32 países. Nuestra sede corporativa está en Dublín, Irlanda. Obtenga más información en experianplc.com.
 Job Description
 Propósito del cargo:
 Ser responsable integral de la experiencia y evolución del journey del cliente dentro del ecosistema MiDataCrédito, asegurando una experiencia fluida, consistente, simple y libre de fricciones en cada punto de interacción, desde la adquisición y activación hasta el uso recurrente, conversión, retención y adopción de productos y servicios.
El rol liderará la optimización continua de los journeys, funcionalidades, contenidos, herramientas y experiencias digitales que soportan el crecimiento de ECS, garantizando que cada etapa sea medible, escalable y orientada a maximizar la satisfacción, conversión, engagement, retención y valor generado por cliente.
Asimismo, será responsable de identificar oportunidades de mejora a partir de investigación de usuarios, analítica de comportamiento, experimentación e inteligencia artificial, trabajando de manera transversal con Producto, Tecnología, Analítica, Marketing, Comercial y Servicio al Cliente.
El cargo tendrá un rol relevante en el cumplimiento del objetivo de crecimiento del 20% en ECS, acelerando mejoras de producto, optimizando la experiencia en app, portales, marketplace, chatbot y soluciones de educación financiera, y transformando insights de clientes y datos en resultados medibles para el negocio.
 Responsabilidades Del Cargo
 Diseñar y optimizar experiencias digitales en canales web, móviles, marketplace y soluciones conversacionales.
 Investigar necesidades, comportamientos y motivaciones de los usuarios mediante entrevistas, encuestas, pruebas de usabilidad y análisis de feedback.
 Crear wireframes, prototipos y propuestas de experiencia centradas en el usuario.
 Analizar métricas, funnels y comportamiento digital para identificar oportunidades de mejora en conversión, engagement y retención.
 Diseñar, ejecutar y evaluar experimentos y pruebas A/B para validar iniciativas de optimización.
 Liderar la evolución de experiencias impulsadas por inteligencia artificial, incluyendo chatbots y soluciones de personalización.
 Mejorar la experiencia de productos financieros, score de crédito, educación financiera y procesos de pago y financiación.
 Traducir insights de clientes y datos de negocio en recomendaciones accionables para equipos de Producto y Tecnología.
 Trabajar de forma transversal con Producto, Tecnología, Analítica, Marketing y áreas comerciales para impulsar resultados de negocio.
 Promover una cultura de diseño, innovación, experimentación y toma de decisiones basada en datos.
 Qualifications
 Educación
 Profesional en Diseño, Diseño de Interacción, Ingeniería, Psicología, Administración, Marketing, Comunicación o carreras afines.
 Deseable especialización o certificaciones en UX/UI, Product Design, Customer Experience, Analítica o Inteligencia Artificial.
 Experiencia
 5 años de experiencia en UX/UI, Product Design o Customer Experience.
 Experiencia en productos digitales web y móviles.
 Experiencia en investigación de usuarios y pruebas de usabilidad.
 Experiencia en analítica digital, optimización y pruebas A/B.
 Trabajo con equipos de Producto, Tecnología y Analítica.
 Deseable experiencia en fintech, servicios financieros o marketplaces.
 Conocimientos
 UX/UI, Product Design y Customer Experience.
 Inteligencia Artificial Generativa y experiencias conversacionales.
 Figma, FigJam y Design Systems.
 Analítica digital, Voice of Customer y A/B Testing.
 Agile, Design Thinking y Service Design.
 Deseable SQL y herramientas de visualización de datos.
 Habilidades
 Orientación al cliente.
 Pensamiento estratégico y analítico.
 Mentalidad de producto.
 Toma de decisiones basada en datos.
 Innovación y creatividad.
 Additional Information

vacantes.descripcion:
Buscamos un perfil versátil, capaz de diseñar interfaces en Figma, crear piezas gráficas en Canva, desarrollar presentaciones animadas y acompañar iniciativas de crecimiento de nuestra comunidad.

**¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?**

* **Coordinación de usuarios semilla:** organizar, acompañar y hacer seguimiento a los usuarios que participan en iniciativas de crecimiento, pruebas y activaciones.
* **Diseño UX/UI:** crear y mejorar interfaces, wireframes y prototipos de nuevas funcionalidades en Figma.
* **Creación de piezas gráficas:** diseñar flyers, publicaciones para redes sociales, banners, piezas promocionales y materiales de comunicación utilizando Canva.
* **Presentaciones animadas:** diseñar presentaciones dinámicas, visualmente atractivas y con animaciones para apoyar a las diferentes áreas de la empresa en reuniones, capacitaciones, propuestas comerciales, informes y presentaciones de proyectos.
* **Diseño de experiencias:** proponer mejoras en la navegación, los flujos de usuario y la experiencia general dentro de la aplicación.
* **Prototipado interactivo:** desarrollar prototipos que permitan comunicar y validar nuevas ideas antes de su implementación.
* **Identidad visual:** mantener la coherencia gráfica de Loopzii en sus diferentes canales, presentaciones y materiales corporativos.
* **Apoyo a marketing:** crear recursos visuales para campañas, lanzamientos, eventos y estrategias de adquisición y participación de usuarios.
* **Apoyo transversal a las áreas:** atender necesidades de comunicación visual y diseño de los equipos de producto, marketing, comercial y otras áreas de la organización.
* **Trabajo colaborativo:** coordinar con los equipos de desarrollo y otras áreas para ejecutar iniciativas y entregar materiales de calidad.

**¿Qué buscamos?**

* Manejo de Figma para diseño de interfaces, wireframes y prototipos.
* Manejo de Canva para crear flyers, piezas gráficas y presentaciones.
* Conocimientos de diseño UX/UI y principios básicos de experiencia de usuario.
* Habilidad para crear presentaciones visuales atractivas, con transiciones y animaciones.
* Capacidad para adaptar diseños y mensajes según el público y el objetivo de cada área.
* Organización, atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar varias tareas.
* Buen criterio visual, creatividad y sensibilidad por la identidad de marca.
* Habilidades de comunicación, autonomía y trabajo en equipo.
* Portafolio o muestras de trabajos en diseño digital, piezas gráficas o presentaciones.

**Será un plus si tienes:**

* Experiencia en startups, aplicaciones móviles o productos digitales.
* Conocimientos básicos de design systems y componentes en Figma.
* Experiencia en investigación UX o pruebas de usabilidad.
* Conocimientos de marketing digital y creación de contenido.
* Manejo de PowerPoint, Google Slides u otras herramientas para presentaciones.
* Experiencia coordinando comunidades, embajadores o programas de usuarios semilla.

Lugar de trabajo: Híbrido en Bogotá, Cundinamarca

**Descripción breve - externa**
-------------------------------

¡Haz historia en la democratización del comercio y de los servicios financieros, transformando la vida de millones de personas en América Latina con Mercado Libre!

Diseña experiencias integrales de facturación e impuestos, conectando investigación, diseño visual y contenido para convertir problemas de producto en flujos claros y completos desde la definición hasta la implementación.

**Desafíos:**

* Investigar problemas junto con Producto y Negocio, cuestionar los pedidos cuando sea necesario y convertir los hallazgos en oportunidades de diseño.
* Explorar alternativas, crear prototipos rápidos y validar soluciones con usuarios; diseñar flujos completos, incluidos los casos de error y las situaciones límite.
* Definir la jerarquía de mensajes, redactar textos y establecer la terminología de las experiencias; aplicar el sistema de diseño Andes y cuidar cada detalle visual hasta la implementación.
* Presentar y defender propuestas con fundamentos, facilitar sesiones de alineación e incorporar herramientas de IA en las distintas etapas del proceso de diseño.

**Experiencia y conocimientos:**

* Aprender con agilidad en base a desafíos, potenciándote con tecnología y GenAI.
* Apasionarse por salir de la zona de confort, dar el máximo, superar los propios límites y emprender en un ambiente sano, alegre y divertido.
* Contar con 3 a 5 años de experiencia en diseño de producto, experiencia de usuario o disciplinas similares, idealmente en productos digitales a escala, y diseñar flujos de punta a punta que contemplen errores y situaciones límite.
* Dominar Figma avanzado, los principios visuales y el trabajo con sistemas de diseño, y cuidar el detalle visual hasta la implementación.
* Comunicarse en español; redactar textos de interfaz y narrativas para presentar el trabajo; usar herramientas de IA en el día a día para investigar, idear, prototipar o escribir y explicar su aplicación; tomar posición y fundamentar decisiones con autonomía, sin supervisión constante.

 Blacksmith Agency builds websites and marketing programs for clients across the US. As Senior Product Designer, Design Systems at Blacksmith, you own how our client design systems get built.  Strong English and overlap with US business hours.

Honeywell Aerospace is seeking an early-career User Experience Designer interested in contributing to the definition and design of elegant, usable products, services, and offerings that improve the lives of our customers and end users while delivering business value.
Our work spans a diverse range of products, services, and technologies, which may include General Aviation, Business Aviation, Commercial and Military aircraft, avionics, Space, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS), Artificial Intelligence (AI), connected products, web and mobile applications, emerging technologies, and immersive experiences.

As a User Experience Designer, you will report to the Sr Manager of User Experience Design and contribute to user research, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and implementation activities. In addition to applying user-centered design methodologies, this position requires the ability to develop and maintain front-end user interfaces using modern web technologies and frameworks. You will contribute throughout the product development lifecycle, from research and concept development through implementation. helping bridge the gap between design and engineering by creating production-ready user interfaces and interactive experiences.
 Responsibilities
 Participate in workshops and design sprints across multidisciplinary teams.
 Develop, enhance, and maintain front-end user interfaces and portals using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
 Contribute to user-centered design initiatives across multiple projects.
 Collaborate with senior designers and stakeholders to improve customer experiences.
 Contribute to UX strategies aligned with business goals.
 Define user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma.
 Participate in user research, usability testing, and synthesis activities.
 Help define design requirements for connected experiences across products and services.
 Translate UX designs into reusable, production-ready front-end components while partnering closely with software engineering teams throughout implementation.
 Support design system documentation and reusable UI components.
 Contribute to the maintenance of design systems and design language standards.
 Stay current on UX trends, accessibility standards, and front-end technologies.
 Qualifications
 YOU MUST HAVE
 Bachelor's degree in a design-related field or equivalent professional experience.
 1–3 years of experience in User Experience Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, Service Design, or related disciplines.
 Experience designing web, applications, and/or mobile apps.
 Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and user flows using Figma.

 interactive prototypes and collaborate effectively with software engineers.

 WE VALUE
 Knowledge of design thinking and UX methodologies.
 Experience developing or maintaining SharePoint sites, pages, or user experiences.
 Experience working in Agile and/or Scrum environments.
 Experience conducting user research and usability testing.
 Experience with journey mapping, service blueprinting, task flows, and information architecture.

 BONUS POINTS FOR
 Previous experience with SharePoint development or customization.

 Diseñar dentro del sistema de diseño de MAJORITY y contribuir a él, creando componentes escalables, bien organizados y fáciles de expandir por otros diseñadores e ingenieros.

 Colaborar con partes interesadas de cumplimiento, riesgo y operaciones para diseñar experiencias que cumplan con los requisitos regulatorios y de KYC sin comprometer la usabilidad.

 Dominio profundo y práctico de Figma (variables, componentes, auto-layout y nomenclatura de capas disciplinada y organizada) con trayectoria en la creación de sistemas de componentes escalables y reutilizables.

 Facilidad para usar Claude (u herramientas de IA similares) para prototipar diseños, además de experiencia diseñando prompts (prompt engineering) para apoyar o automatizar partes de tu flujo de trabajo de diseño.

 Un portafolio que muestre la autoría completa de principio a fin: cómo planteas los problemas, exploras enfoques y llegas a soluciones lanzadas, no solo pantallas finales pulidas.
 Soltura en el uso de datos para orientar las decisiones de diseño: lectura del abandono en el embudo, segmentación de uso o hallazgos de investigación para convertirlos en dirección de diseño.
 Excelente capacidad de comunicación para explicar y defender los fundamentos del diseño ante ingenieros, product managers y otros colaboradores, así como de recibir comentarios para convertirlos en mejores decisiones de diseño.
 Empatía con las comunidades a las que sirve MAJORITY e interés genuino en diseñar para personas que construyen su vida financiera.
 Comodidad trabajando en entornos de habla inglesa.

 Experiencia con productos financieros para inmigrantes, sectores no bancarizados o mercados emergentes.

About Revun
 Revun is building a next-generation software platform designed to modernize how property owners, property managers, brokerages, maintenance providers, service professionals, and real estate organizations operate.
The platform combines CRM, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, workflow automation, compliance, reporting, AI, integrations, and stakeholder portals into a single operating platform.
Our goal is not to build another collection of disconnected software tools. We are building an operational platform that simplifies complex business processes, reduces manual work, improves visibility, and helps organizations operate more efficiently.
The product is already underway, and we are now looking for a strong product designer who can help turn a complex platform into an intuitive, professional, scalable, and commercially ready user experience.
 About The Role
 Revun is hiring a Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) to lead the design of our web and mobile product experience.
This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.
We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi-user systems.

**About Yumwoof**

At Yumwoof, we're redefining pet wellness with science-backed, anti-inflammatory dog food made from real ingredients. We're in the middle of a full rebrand and a heavy product-launch calendar. We have more approved creative ideas than we can get produced, checked and shipped. This role is the person who closes that gap every week.

**About the Role**

Most paid design roles are about making the ads. This one is about half making them and half getting them made.

We already have a creative system: a concept library, a brief-to-live pipeline in ClickUp, a naming standard, a shoot library, and seven production partners doing statics, motion and UGC. What we don't have is one person holding the whole thing to a weekly deadline. Right now that job is split across people who each have another job.

So it's two halves of roughly equal weight. Half producer: working alongside Marketing to get our video and UGC actually made (scenarios briefed, creators and editors booked, footage in on the date, cuts reviewed and shipped). Half designer: owning our statics (building them yourself where that's fastest, commissioning them from an agency where it isn't, and being the person who decides whether what comes back is good enough to run).

If both halves sound like work you'd want, read on!

**What You’ll Own (and What You Won’t Own)**

**YOURS**

**Producer Half: Video and UGC, with Marketing**

* **Getting video and UGC made**. Scenarios briefed, creators and editors booked, footage in on the date, cuts back and shipped.
* **The partner roster.** Seven production partners: who gets which brief, by when, and whether what came back is usable.
* **The seam with Marketing**. Shoots, creators and brand assets are theirs. You're the person making sure paid gets what it needs out of that work, early enough to use it.
* **Recuts of what's working**. Hooks worth a second version, winners worth extending, whitelisting candidates surfaced to Growth.

**Designer Half: Statics**

* **Statics, made or commissioned.** You build them where that's fastest and brief an agency where it isn't. Either way they're yours.
* **Variants and swaps**. Winners extended, offer and badge changes for live promos, ratio adaptations.
* **The template library.** The thing that keeps volume possible as spend grows.

**Both Halves**

* **QA on everything that comes back**. Ingredient claims, product naming, safe zones, platform specs, naming standard.
* **Brief quality**. What each maker receives (concept, format, ratio, hook, offer, references).
* **The pipeline and the Monday flight.** Every asset's movement, its Ready-by date, and a complete batch landing traffic-ready each week.

**NOT YOURS (and that’s deliberate)**

* **Concept Approval**: Sits with Growth. Ideas are approved before they reach you. You execute them, and you're welcome to shape them.
* **Spend, Targeting, and Budget**: sits with Growth.
* **Whitelisting Decisions**: Growth decides on UGC winners and You commission the recuts.
* **The Content Calendar**: Marketing decides what we shoot and when, and owns the blog, organic social and email partners. You partner with them on production and tell them what paid needs. You don't run their calendar.
* **What Gets Tested Next**: Growth sets priorities off performance. You turn them into assets.

**Your First 90 Days**

**DAYS 0 – 14**

**Learn the system we already have**

Our pipeline, naming standard, concept library and partner roster all exist and are in use. Week one is learning them. Week two you start clearing the queue. If you spot something broken, tell us.

**DAYS 15–45**

**Get to a reliable weekly flight**

Every Monday, a complete batch lands traffic-ready without anyone chasing it. The backlog starts visibly shrinking. The template library grows out of the work you're doing anyway.

**DAYS 46–90**

**Hit creative numbers for every week and hold it through a launch**

New assets a week across statics and video, sustained — including through BFCM, which runs in four waves. Partners and creators deliver to your dates. Growth stops being involved in whether creative will be ready, and goes back to deciding what to test.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Performance Creative Experience:** 3+ years making performance creative for DTC or e-commerce. A portfolio with volume in it, statics and video both, not just showpieces. Meta above all; TikTok and Google are useful.
* **Pipeline Management:** Evidence you've run a pipeline, not just filled one. You've held outside partners to dates, written briefs people could actually work from, and kept files findable.
* **QA & Compliance Instinct:** A real QA instinct. We sell food. Ingredient claims, product names and substantiated comparisons are not details — getting one wrong is a genuine problem, not a typo.
* **Video Production Coordination:** Production coordination on video. You've run creators and editors to a schedule — scenarios written, footage chased, cuts reviewed — and you can trim or tidy something yourself when that's faster than sending it back.
* **Modular Design Systems:** Figma auto-layout, components and variants, so one idea becomes three ratios and six hooks without starting over. Adobe CS as needed.
