**At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.**

**Job Description:**

**Job Title:** Bakery Cake Designer

**Department:** Bakery

**FLSA:** Hourly

**Revision Date:** 07/2026

**About Hy-Vee**

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

**The Role and Why It's Important**

At Hy-Vee, our bakery department helps customers celebrate life's biggest moments, and our Bakery Cake Designers are at the heart of making those moments special. In this role, you'll use your creativity and decorating skills to bring customer visions to life, from birthday cakes and everyday treats to wedding cakes delivered and set up on site. You'll also serve as a lead for part-time employees and collaborate closely with the bakery team to keep production running smoothly.

If you have a passion for decorating, an eye for detail, and enjoy working with customers to create something memorable, we'd love to have you on our team.

**What You'll Do**

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

* Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile, taking orders at the bakery counter, and assisting them with their needs throughout the store
* Check orders for the day, set up a timeline and production schedule, and check cake orders daily for details including size, deco pack, icing needs, and dates
* Decorate bakery items in a timely manner, keeping current on new designs and trends
* Develop daily bakery orders for bakers including cakes and sizes needed
* Track daily retail production and identify tasks to be completed with co-workers
* Check product dates, pull cases for work, and list items to fill or replace
* Order supplies for the decorating area and check off the order upon receipt
* Deliver product and set up wedding cakes on site outside the store
* Communicate with the Bakery Manager daily regarding displays, weekly ads, and special needs
* Operate as a lead with part-time and other employees by instructing and reviewing their work
* Participate in employee cross-training
* Practice proper sanitation procedures and keep the work area clean, neat, and safe at all times
* Answer the phone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call, including taking product orders
* Follow Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all department and company guidelines
* Pitch in with other tasks or special projects as they come up

**Your Skills**

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to:

* Bring commitment to Hy-Vee's mission and a genuine passion for delivering an outstanding customer experience
* Apply strong decorating skills and stay current on cake design trends and techniques
* Solve practical problems and follow instructions carefully in a fast-paced environment
* Apply math skills including fractions, decimals, and percentages in day-to-day tasks
* Lead and guide part-time employees, providing instruction and reviewing their work
* Communicate clearly with customers, co-workers, and the Bakery Manager

**Reporting Relationships**

**Accountable and Reports to:** Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Perishables, Store Operations, Health Wellness Home; Bakery Department Manager

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent experience
* Six months or less of similar or related work experience; we'll provide all the training you need to succeed

**Physical Requirements**

* Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas
* Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation
* Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment
* Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards
* Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

**Working Environment**

This is a fast-moving role with significant pressure to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities. You'll work in the bakery department and can expect exposure to flour dust, noise, temperature extremes, cleaning chemicals and solvents, and residual fumes. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

*Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.*

vacantes.descripcion:
WON is building the next generation of AI transformation for enterprise organizations. We are not another AI tools vendor. We build AI-native systems, combined with deep human judgment and category expertise, that fundamentally change how our clients operate, make decisions, and serve their customers. 
 Within that, our design practice works with premium DTC and ecommerce brands doing $50M to $500M+ in revenue: brands with strong products and strong followings that are still leaving growth on the table. We are not a “make it pretty” agency, and we are not another CRO shop running button tests. We combine deep behavioral insight with quantitative truth, then ship exceptional work fast, and we are building the AI-native systems that let us do it at a pace and scale traditional design teams cannot match.
 About WON 
 WON is building the next generation of AI transformation for enterprise organizations. We are not another AI tools vendor. We build AI-native systems, combined with deep human judgment and category expertise, that fundamentally change how our clients operate, make decisions, and serve their customers. 
 Within that, our design practice works with premium DTC and ecommerce brands doing $50M to $500M+ in revenue: brands with strong products and strong followings that are still leaving growth on the table. We are not a “make it pretty” agency, and we are not another CRO shop running button tests. We combine deep behavioral insight with quantitative truth, then ship exceptional work fast, and we are building the AI-native systems that let us do it at a pace and scale traditional design teams cannot match. 
 AI powers our systems. Taste powers our design. The two compound each other: automation gives you the speed, and your judgment decides what is actually good. 
 This role reports to the VP of Design and works within the design roadmap they set. 
 What You’ll Own 
 End-to-end execution of high-conversion experiences, full customer journey redesigns, and high-performance growth creative, scoped by the design roadmap and delivered in close collaboration with the VP of Design 
 The WON design standard: clean, premium, behavior-driven, detail-obsessed, and fast to ship 
 Adoption of WON 's AI-native design systems, including Claude Design and Figma MCP, to move from concept to shippable work faster 
 Automated asset creation built on our Figma component libraries, so variations and scale stop being manual work 
 Contributing to the expansion of WON ’s design agents and workflows, flagging what should be automated next
 How Success Is Measured 
 Conversion and AOV move measurably on the experiences you touch 
 Customers move further through the funnel because of design decisions you made 
 High-quality design ships fast, with less time lost between concept and production 
 Component libraries and AI-assisted workflows reduce manual design work over time, not just for you but for the whole team 
 Your work becomes the most reliable design output at WON , the standard new hires are measured against
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design high-conversion sites and landing pages that still feel premium, the kind that belong in the top 1% 
 Design the full customer journey: acquisition landing flows, onboarding, collection architecture, PDP storytelling, cart and checkout, retention and member UX 
 Design growth creative: paid social landing pages, advertorials, quiz flows, product education, bundles and upsell, offer frameworks that feel intentional, not desperate 
 Build and maintain component libraries and design systems that scale across brands and campaigns 
 Use Claude Design, Figma MCP, and automated asset generation to reduce production time without reducing quality 
 Continuously evaluate your own workflow and flag what should be turned into a repeatable system or agent 
 Present work with conviction, backed by session replays, cohort behavior, and voice of customer
 Must-Have: 
 5+ years in digital design, agency or in-house 
 Strong ecommerce / DTC experience 
 A portfolio of modern, premium work, not template-driven 
 Mastery in Figma 
 Strong typography instincts, real ones 
 Taste that holds up under scrutiny: you can articulate why a design decision is right, not just that it feels right 
 Comfortable being measured by impact, not just output 
 Familiarity with AI design tools such as Claude Design or Figma MCP, or genuine interest in building them into your workflow
 Nice-to-Have: 
 Designed for high-end brands (beauty, apparel, wellness, premium food) 
 Experience working within Shopify ecosystems 
 Built component libraries and design systems from scratch 
 Contributed to CRO programs that produced measurable performance gains
 Portfolio / Proof of Work Expectation 
 We Value 
 Modern, premium design work, not template-driven 
 Evidence your design decisions moved a real metric: conversion, AOV, or funnel progression 
 Systems thinking: component libraries and reusable frameworks, not just one-off screens 
 Comfort presenting and defending design decisions with data
 How We Work / Culture 
 Design is treated as a growth system, not a decoration function 
 Insights come first: every decision is grounded in customer behavior and tied to KPIs 
 AI and automation are used to eliminate manual production work, not to replace judgment 
 High clarity, ownership, and craft are core values: work ships fast instead of dying in Figma
 Why Join WON 
 Build design systems that move revenue for brands doing $50M to $500M+ in revenue 
 Work at the intersection of design, behavioral insight, and AI-native workflows 
 High ownership over execution, with a clear roadmap and a VP of Design invested in your growth 
 Collaborate with a founder-led team with taste and urgency, and full access to the truth: session replays, cohort data, voice of customer 
 Help build the AI design systems, including Claude Design, Figma MCP, and automated component workflows, that define how WON designs at scale 
 Competitive base rates: USD$2500-$6000/month depending on skills
 If you want to be a career designer, this probably isn’t for you. If you want to become an elite operator-designer who builds work that changes brands and makes numbers move, we’d love to meet you.

¡Nos complace ofrecer a nuestros colaboradores de la oficina de Bogotá el beneficio de trabajar desde casa un día a la semana! Esta flexibilidad refleja nuestro compromiso con su bienestar y con promover un equilibrio saludable entre la vida laboral y personal.
  
  
Diseñador(a) Eléctrico(a) III – Revit
  
Únete a nuestro equipo
  
  
Envía tu resume en inglés para postularte
  
  
Estamos buscando un(a) Diseñador(a) Eléctrico(a) III para unirse a nuestro equipo en Bogotá. Esta posición es ideal para un profesional con sólida experiencia en diseño eléctrico utilizando Autodesk Revit, que desee participar en proyectos internacionales y trabajar en colaboración directa con equipos de Estados Unidos.
  
  
Tendrás la oportunidad de participar en proyectos de diferentes industrias y mercados, contribuyendo al desarrollo de soluciones de ingeniería de alta calidad y apoyando la evolución de los estándares y flujos de trabajo del equipo.
  
  
Responsabilidades
  

* Desarrollar modelos y planos eléctricos utilizando Autodesk Revit y AutoCAD.
* Elaborar documentación técnica y entregables de ingeniería para proyectos multidisciplinarios.
* Coordinar diseños con equipos de ingeniería y arquitectura.
* Colaborar directamente con el equipo de Estados Unidos para optimizar procesos y estándares de modelado en Revit.
* Contribuir a la mejora continua de los flujos de trabajo y las mejores prácticas del equipo.
* Apoyar el desarrollo de estándares BIM y la calidad de los entregables.

Requisitos
  

* Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en diseño eléctrico dentro de empresas de consultoría de ingeniería, arquitectura o construcción (AEC).
* Dominio avanzado de Autodesk Revit (requisito indispensable).
* Experiencia en Autodesk AutoCAD.
* Se valorará experiencia con AutoCAD Electrical.
* Se valorará experiencia en gestión de bases de datos utilizando Microsoft Access o SQL.
* Experiencia trabajando en equipos multidisciplinarios y en el desarrollo de documentación técnica de ingeniería.
* Capacidad para gestionar múltiples tareas, trabajar de manera autónoma y mantener altos estándares de calidad.
* Nivel de inglés mínimo B2 (requisito indispensable), con capacidad para participar en reuniones y comunicarse regularmente con equipos internacionales.

Valoraremos especialmente
  

* Experiencia liderando o apoyando equipos de diseño.
* Interés en desarrollar y optimizar procesos de modelado BIM.
* Proactividad, iniciativa y orientación a la mejora continua.
* Interés en crecer hacia un rol de liderazgo técnico.

Si buscas desarrollar tu carrera en un entorno internacional, participar en proyectos desafiantes y trabajar con un equipo altamente colaborativo, nos encantaría conocerte.
  
  
Todos los cargos en Pond & Company requieren la participación en al menos una entrevista presencial como parte de nuestro proceso de contratación, y la mayoría de los puestos también requieren un proceso de inducción presencial en una de las oficinas de Pond; los candidatos deben esperar reunirse directamente con nuestro equipo y deben ser cautelosos ante cualquier comunicación que sugiera lo contrario.
  
Acerca de Pond
  
Pond es una firma galardonada de servicios integrales en arquitectura, ingeniería, planeación, gerencia de construcción y servicios ambientales, que ha brindado soluciones profesionales a clientes en todo Estados Unidos y a nivel global por casi 60 años. El equipo de más de 800 profesionales de Pond ofrece una amplia experiencia y capacidades que permiten desarrollar soluciones personalizadas para ayudar a los clientes a gestionar proyectos desde la concepción hasta la finalización —y todo lo que ocurre en el proceso— con confianza y claridad. Actualmente, Pond ocupa el puesto número 80 entre las firmas de ingeniería y diseño más grandes según ENR, es la firma de ingeniería número 1 en Atlanta de acuerdo con el Atlanta Business Chronicle, y ha sido reconocida como Empleador del Año por Georgia ACEC, así como uno de los Mejores Lugares para Trabajar para Padres que Trabajan.
  
  
Información adicional
  
En Pond se consideran múltiples factores para determinar la compensación, incluyendo el alcance y nivel del cargo, la ubicación geográfica, así como las habilidades, conocimientos y experiencia del candidato. El salario base inicial puede variar dependiendo de estos factores. Por favor, consulte el rango salarial asociado a esta vacante para obtener más información.
  
Todas las ofertas de empleo realizadas por Pond & Company están sujetas a la aprobación de los resultados de una verificación de antecedentes. Se llevarán a cabo verificaciones de antecedentes previas al empleo para todos los candidatos a quienes se les ofrezca un cargo en Pond, en cumplimiento con la política del programa, así como con las regulaciones estatales y federales. Adicionalmente, las ofertas podrán estar condicionadas a la aprobación de una prueba de detección de drogas y alcohol previa al empleo.
  
  
Empleador con Igualdad de Oportunidades
  
Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y reconocemos el valor de la diversidad y la inclusión en el lugar de trabajo. Las decisiones de contratación en Pond se basan en las necesidades del negocio, los requisitos del cargo y las cualificaciones individuales. Todos los candidatos debidamente calificados recibirán consideración para empleo. Prohibimos la discriminación y el acoso de cualquier tipo, basados en raza, color, sexo, edad, religión, orientación sexual, origen nacional, discapacidad, información genética, embarazo o cualquier otra característica protegida según lo estipulado por las leyes federales, estatales y locales en las jurisdicciones d

vacantes.titulo: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems (Remote, Barranquilla)
vacantes.descripcion:
Blacksmith Agency
 Design
 Full time
 Remote (Latin America)
 About The Role
 Blacksmith Agency builds websites and marketing programs for clients across the US. As Senior Product Designer, Design Systems at Blacksmith, you own how our client design systems get built. You take a brand and a few reference sites, then extract the pattern into a working system: tokens, variables, modes, and core components a build pipeline can execute without asking you questions. Precision is the job.
This is a senior, systems-first seat. Not one-off pages, not maintenance. You stand up new systems fast and get them right the first time, across several client brands at once.
 What You Will Own
 Build token architecture in Figma using variables, modes, and semantic naming our pipeline can read predictably.
 Ship core component libraries that hold up across an entire site, not just a homepage.
 Document the system so a developer or an automated pipeline can execute it without questions.
 Work across several client brands at once, each looking distinctly different, with the same structural rigor.
 What You Bring
 4+ years designing for the web, with real design system work in your portfolio.
 Fluency in Figma variables, component properties, auto layout, and variants. Actual architecture, not just tidy files.
 A portfolio where the work looks different from client to client but the rigor underneath is the same.
 Strong English and overlap with US business hours.
 How To Apply
 Apply in two minutes at the link. Your application is reviewed once you finish a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment, so use the same email throughout.

Descripción de la empresa
We are Publicis Production Hub (PPH) , the production house of Publicis Groupe, a global team with a strong presence in Colombia where creativity, production, post-production, sound, media and data come together to turn ideas into content that transforms brands into cultural icons; we work as one team, valuing diverse perspectives and generating value beyond creativity, with the ambition to drive our clients’ transformation, growth and greatness under the promise: Pioneering What’s Possible.
Descripción del puesto
 At Publicis Production, Bogotá - Colombia , we are looking for a Senior Creative Designer with more than 5 years of experience in similar roles within digital, creative, print, and editorial production environments . The mission of this role will be to conceptualize and execute high‑quality creative solutions across both digital and print media, ensuring all deliverables are aligned with brand strategy, creative standards, and client objectives within a global production model.
Responsabilidades
 Conceptualize, design, and develop creative assets across digital and print formats, including editorial content and production‑ready materials.
 Actively participate in ideation sessions, brainstorming, and creative reviews, contributing strong conceptual thinking and innovative solutions.
 Deliver high‑quality visual design across multiple formats such as websites, emails, banners, printed materials, editorial layouts, and campaign assets.
 Develop and adapt key visuals across channels, ensuring brand consistency and visual excellence.
 Lead the execution of editorial and print pieces, ensuring compliance with technical production and prepress requirements.
 Prepare final print‑ready files, ensuring correct setup (color profiles, resolution, bleed, file formats, and technical specifications).
 Execute creative production tasks such as image retouching, illustration, infographics, presentations, basic animations, and design adaptations.
 Collaborate closely with creative, marketing, and development teams to deliver user‑centered and business‑aligned solutions.
 Ensure all deliverables are aligned with brand guidelines, creative direction, and strategic objectives.
 Mentor and support junior designers, promoting best practices and high‑quality standards across the team.
 Present creative proposals and effectively communicate design decisions to stakeholders.
 Stay up to date with design trends, tools, and emerging technologies.
 Cualificaciones
 Minimum of 5 years of experience in creative design, with strong expertise in both digital and print/editorial environments.
 Proven experience in visual design, web design, and creative production.
 Strong experience working across multiple formats and media (digital, print, editorial).
 Solid knowledge of prepress and graphic production processes.
 Strong understanding of typography, color, composition, and layout principles.
 Ability to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling.
 A strong portfolio demonstrating a variety of digital and print design projects.
 Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Sketch, and similar.
 Knowledge of motion graphics, UX, or front‑end development is a plus.
 Intermediate‑to‑advanced English proficiency (B2 or higher).
 Información adicional
 Access to Marcel, our AI-powered connection platform featuring top-tier e-learning tools like Udemy and LinkedIn Learning. Dive into 30,000+ courses across diverse fields to upskill at your own pace. Connect with 100,000+ creative minds across Publicis Groupe's global network.
 Premium benefits including: Hybrid work, employee savings fund, life insurance, birthday day off, plus opportunities to apply for global roles within our network. Experience our Work Your World initiative: work remotely for up to 6 weeks per year from any country where Publicis Groupe operates.
 Viva la difference Publicis Groupe harnesses #ThePowerOfOne , fusing creativity and technology while celebrating #VivaLaDifference . We recognize and champion individual differences as strengths that enrich our teams and communities. Diversity and inclusion aren’t just values—they fuel our success!

vacantes.titulo: Piping designer / dibujante o delineante de tuberías, medellin
vacantes.descripcion:
Título del cargo: Piping Designer / Dibujante o delineante de tuberías, Medellin
Resumen del cargo
En Adecco Colombia buscamos un/a Piping Designer / Diseñador de tuberías para unirse a proyectos industriales de alto impacto en Medellín. La persona seleccionada será responsable del desarrollo de modelos 3D de tuberías inteligentes y de entregables 2D, apoyando la solución de problemas técnicos y colaborando de manera propositiva con equipos multidisciplinarios.
Responsabilidades principales
Diseñar y modelar sistemas de tuberías para proyectos industriales.
Elaborar planos, isométricos y documentación técnica de ingeniería.
Participar en proyectos de ingeniería conceptual, básica y de detalle.
Interpretar diagramas PFD y P&ID para el desarrollo de diseños.
Coordinar actividades con disciplinas mecánicas, eléctricas, civiles e instrumentación.
Identificar y gestionar interferencias en modelos 3D.
Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares, especificaciones y requerimientos del proyecto.
Apoyar la solución de problemas técnicos asociados a tuberías.
Requisitos del cargo
Formación Técnica o tecnóloga en diseño o ingeniería
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en diseño de tuberías.
Experiencia en sectores de Minería, Metales, Petróleo y Gas (Oil & Gas) o similares.
Experiencia en diseño y modelado de tuberías, incluyendo soportes, conexiones, accesorios e integración con el modelo general de planta.
Manejo de herramientas CAD 3D inteligente, preferiblemente suites Bentley y/o Intergraph.
Conocimiento en preparación de entregables 2D.
Conocimiento de componentes y materiales de tuberías.
Conocimiento de normas y códigos industriales o reglamentarios como ASME y API.
Conocimiento de flujos de trabajo típicos de la disciplina de tuberías.
Manejo de diagramas de flujo de proceso (PFD) y diagramas de tubería e instrumentos (P&ID).
Competencias deseadas
Orientación al detalle y a la calidad técnica.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo multidisciplinario.
Comunicación efectiva y actitud colaborativa.
Proactividad para resolver problemas y proponer mejoras.
Adaptabilidad a entornos de proyecto dinámicos.
Condiciones de la vacante
Ubicación: Medellín, Colombia.
Modalidad: 100 % presencial en Edificio FIC 48, El Poblado.
Tipo de contrato: Término indefinido.
Salario: De acuerdo con la experiencia.
Jornada: Se cuenta con dos opciones de horario:
Lunes a jueves de 6:30 a. m. a 4:30 p. m. y viernes de 6:30 a. m. a 12:30 p. m.
Lunes a jueves de 7:00 a. m. a 5:00 p. m. y viernes de 7:00 a. m. a 1:00 p. m.
Vacantes disponibles: 8.
Lo que ofrecemos
Vinculación directa a través de Adecco Colombia.
Participación en proyectos retadores y de alto nivel técnico.
Entorno de trabajo colaborativo y orientado al crecimiento profesional.
Oportunidad de aportar al desarrollo de soluciones de ingeniería para sectores estratégicos.
Cultura y valores
En Adecco promovemos entornos inclusivos, colaborativos y enfocados en el desarrollo del talento. Valoramos la diversidad de experiencias y perspectivas, y buscamos personas comprometidas con la excelencia, la seguridad y la mejora continua.
Proceso de postulación
Si cumples con el perfil y quieres hacer parte de este proceso, postúlate y adjunta tu hoja de vida actualizada. Nuestro equipo de selección revisará tu perfil y se comunicará con las personas que avancen en el proceso.

vacantes.titulo: Mechanical designer / dibujante o delineante mecánico - medellín
vacantes.descripcion:
Titulo del cargo: Mechanical Designer / Dibujante o delineante Mecánico - Medellín
Sobre el cargo
En Adecco Colombia estamos en búsqueda de un(a) Diseñador(a) Mecánico(a) para apoyar el desarrollo de diseños, modelos y documentación técnica para proyectos industriales. Esta posición requiere experiencia en ingeniería básica y de detalle, modelado 3D y elaboración de planos, así como la capacidad de trabajar de manera coordinada con diferentes disciplinas de ingeniería para asegurar entregables de alta calidad.
Responsabilidades principales
Desarrollar diseños y modelos mecánicos para proyectos industriales.
Elaborar planos y documentación técnica para ingeniería básica y de detalle.
Participar en el modelado 3D de instalaciones y plantas industriales.
Coordinar actividades de diseño con otras disciplinas de ingeniería.
Revisar y validar planos y entregables técnicos.
Realizar detección de interferencias en modelos multidisciplinarios.
Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares, especificaciones y requerimientos del proyecto.
Requisitos del cargo
Tecnólogo(a) o profesional en Diseño Mecánico, Ingeniería Mecánica o carreras afines.
Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en diseño mecánico o experiencia relevante equivalente.
Experiencia en ingeniería básica y de detalle.
Experiencia en modelado 3D y elaboración de planos de ingeniería.
Conocimiento en diseño de plantas industriales, equipos mecánicos y distribución de planta.

 What You'll Bring
